creatures.name: Momentum Fox
creatures.desc: A swift fox that embodies the conservation of momentum. It accelerates without losing direction.

creatures.name: Vector Hawk
creatures.desc: A soaring hawk that visualizes force vectors. Every wingbeat resolves into components.

creatures.name: Gravion
creatures.desc: A heavy stone guardian that warps spacetime around it. Feared by all who defy gravity.

creatures.name: Thermix
creatures.desc: A flame spirit born from volcanic energy. It converts heat to work with perfect efficiency.

creatures.name: Impulse Hare
creatures.desc: A lightning-fast hare that delivers devastating impulse in short time intervals.

creatures.name: Circuit Crab
creatures.desc: A mechanical crab that moves in perfect circles. Its shell displays real-time centripetal force.

creatures.name: Voltix
creatures.desc: A crackling energy spirit born from a million volts. It stores charge in its crystalline body.

creatures.name: Hydron
creatures.desc: An aquatic spirit that generates powerful magnetic fields using electromagnetic induction.

creatures.name: Photonix
creatures.desc: A luminous butterfly that bends light at will. Its wings are living prisms.

creatures.name: Wave Dolphin
creatures.desc: A dolphin that rides sound waves across the ocean. It communicates in every frequency.

creatures.name: Quark Sprite
creatures.desc: A particle sprite that exists in superposition. It changes state when observed.
